mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline for 3 months, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days by signaling labor market strength and reduced policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.0% in the next month, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary) indicate accommodative policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 does not rise while FEDFUNDS falls, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 3.5% amplifies accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Not in late-cycle expansion regime, or FEDFUNDS does not fall below 3.5%, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 107.0 signals supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 107.0, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) indicate robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not rise, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low-rate environment, a drop in UNRATE below 3.0% may signal labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Not in low-rate environment, or UNRATE does not fall below 3.0%, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above 110.0 indicates robust supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 110.0, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
